title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
description: Voyager is an agent that plays Minecraft autonomously. It maintains a skill library — a code base of executable skills (e.g., "mine_diamond", "build_shelter") — and continually writes new skills as LLM-generated JavaScript programs, testing them in the environment. Skills are retrieved via embedding similarity and reused in new contexts. Demonstrates open-ended lifelong learning.
authors: Wang, Xie, Jiang, Mandlekar, Xiao, Zhu, Fan, Anandkumar (NVIDIA / Caltech)
